# QR generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified browser source from `qrcode-generator@1.4.4`, by
Kazuhiko Arase, distributed under the MIT license. See `LICENSE-qrcode.txt`.

- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Pinned package file: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js

The standalone page generates QR matrices locally. It does not send image links
or API credentials to a remote QR-code service.
